sentences.en: The zoo has many other attractions aside from the penguins.
sentences.zh: 除了企鹅之外，动物园还有许多其他吸引人的地方。

sentences.en: If penguins ever learn to fly, we'll be in serious trouble.
sentences.zh: 如果企鹅学会飞翔的话，我们就会遇到大麻烦了。

sentences.en: Penguins move gracefully in water and awkwardly on land.
sentences.zh: 企鹅在水中游动优雅，在陆地上行走则显得笨拙。
